gemini_setup_get_key: Open Google AI Studio → sign in → Create API key
gemini_setup_intro: Walkthrough videos are analyzed by Google's Gemini — the model that understands video best today. You'll need a free Gemini API key (no credit card required).
gemini_setup_key_help: That doesn't look like an API key — copy the whole value from aistudio.google.com/apikey.
gemini_setup_placeholder: Paste your Gemini API key here
gemini_setup_saved: Gemini is set up — back to your walkthrough.
gemini_setup_title: Set up Gemini for video analysis
record_walkthrough_hint: Tip: capture just the window you're testing — smaller recordings upload faster.
record_walkthrough_title: You'll pick what to share next. Recording a single window (not the whole screen) keeps the upload small and analyzes just as well.
walkthrough_analyzed: Walkthrough analyzed — the summary landed in the chat.
walkthrough_analyzing_narration: Reading the screen and your narration…
walkthrough_annotate_accessibility_hint: {{shortcut}} to draw — allow Accessibility for hold
walkthrough_annotate_accessibility_note: For hold-to-draw, allow Syrus under System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility, then start a new recording.
walkthrough_annotate_surface_note: On-screen drawing only appears when you share your whole screen.
walkthrough_disabled: Walkthrough videos are not enabled on this instance — an admin can turn them on under Features.
walkthrough_no_mic: No mic — narration won't be captured
walkthrough_no_other_attachments: Send the walkthrough on its own — remove image or file attachments and send them in a separate message.
walkthrough_one_at_a_time: A walkthrough is already being processed — wait for it to finish, then add another.
walkthrough_media_expired: Video was cleaned up after its retention window — the analysis is kept.
walkthrough_too_large: That video is over 500 MB. Trim it or record at a lower resolution.
walkthrough_too_long: That video is {{actual}} long — walkthroughs are capped at {{limit}} so the analysis stays fast and free-tier friendly.
walkthrough_window_hint: Tip: keep the window small for a faster analysis
